faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CSL Officer (Skill Development) on contract basis Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the CSL Officer (Skill Development) on contract basis post is 01 October 2026. Candidates are advised to apply well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in the CSL Officer (Skill Development) on contract basis recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Officer (Skill Development) on contract basis post in Cochin Shipyard. These positions are offered on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification for the Officer (Skill Development) post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a three-year Diploma in Mechanical Engineering from a State Board of Technical Education or an equivalent qualification to be eligible for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to the CSL Officer (Skill Development) position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Officer (Skill Development) on contract basis post is 62 years. There is no minimum age specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for CSL Officer (Skill Development) recruitment?
faq.answer: The application fee is ₹ 400/- for General/OBC categories. Candidates belonging to SC/ST categories are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Officer (Skill Development) on contract basis post at CSL?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Officer (Skill Development) on contract basis post will receive a salary of Rs. 43750 Per Month. This is a consolidated pay for the contract period.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for CSL Officer (Skill Development) recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Officer (Skill Development) on contract basis post includes two stages: Certificate Verification, followed by a Personal Interview. Candidates must clear both stages.

faq.question: Q8. How can I apply for the CSL Officer (Skill Development) on contract basis recruitment?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official Cochin Shipyard website. The application window opens on 16 September 2026, and the last date to apply is 01 October 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the job location be for the Officer (Skill Development) post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Officer (Skill Development) on contract basis post will be in Kochi, Kerala. Cochin Shipyard is headquartered in Kochi, which is the primary work location.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website to find more details about this recruitment?
faq.answer: For more detailed information regarding the CSL Officer (Skill Development) on contract basis recruitment, candidates should visit the official website of Cochin Shipyard at www.cochinshipyard.in.
